“报官？”冯全跳起来就要大骂，“你赶紧报，老子就是……”
梁浩海却一把拦住了他，他们出来办差是秘密进行，不好随便暴露了身分。
他直接从荷包里拿出一只银锞子扔给掌柜，“我们只住一晚，若是还不答应，就是给脸不要脸了，别怪我们以后为难你。”
掌柜不过是虚张声势，这会儿得了银子，又见梁浩海两人不是好欺负的，就软了态度应道：“我也不是不愿意接待，实在是这位姑娘伤得太重了，万一惹上官司，或者这姑娘有个好歹，我们坏了名声，以后不好做生意。”
“放心，保管不给你这店里惹麻烦。有后院的空房给我们安排一间，万一有什么不好，也不给你添晦气。”
“好，那劳烦客人随我来。后院有间耳房，小了一些，但还干净，适合这姑娘养伤。”掌柜说得好，其实就是不想他们入住客栈的房间，万一这姑娘死在里边，以后的客人会忌讳。
幸好，这间耳房经常打扫，虽简陋一些，却也勉强能安身。
梁浩海嘱咐冯全守着，自个儿赶紧去寻童家大院。
可惜，这么一耽搁，天色早就黑透了。他寻到童家大院时，童家大门合拢得严严实实，任凭他怎么敲，里面也没人回应。
余姑娘的伤势太重，随时都会死去，他实在等不得，只能剑走偏锋了……
童家大院不算小，五进的大宅还带了一个小花园，花园的东北角建了一栋二层阁楼，童家大小姐童悠悠就住在其中。
暗夜里，声音本就传得极远极清楚，门口有人拍动，阁楼里也听了几声。
童悠悠放下手里的医书，朝着大门方向张望，问道：“小桃，可知大门外是什么人来访？”
小桃只有十五岁，长得白胖粉嫩，因为自小贴身伺候主子，深知主子的脾气随和，也不觉得如何拘谨，这会儿就一边啃着果子，一边随口应道：“哎呀，小姐，敲咱们家里门的，能是什么人，肯定是求医的啊。”
她还想说几句，后脑杓却被人拍了一记。
一个穿了莲青色衣裙的妇人从门外进来，嗔怪的瞪了小桃一眼，恼道：“没规矩！一盘果子，小姐没吃一个，倒是让你吃了一半！”
说话的妇人是大小姐的奶娘陈嫂子，家里男人是这童家大院的管家，很得老夫人信赖，陈嫂子为人爽快心善，阁楼里的大小丫鬟都受她管束。
小桃吓得含了一嘴的果子，赶紧躲去小姐身边求救，“小姐，我下次再也不敢了。”
童悠悠好笑，望向陈嫂子，“陈嫂，小桃年岁还小，不要同她计较了，明日罚她给我扫院子就好了，再说我也没胃口，她把果子吃了，省得明日蔫掉就浪费了。”
陈嫂子本也不是严厉的人，主子开口，她自然不能抓着不放，于是又瞪了小桃一眼，见她缩着脖子，一副小心翼翼的模样，忍不住笑了，但嘴上仍说：“下不为例，明早扫院子。”

“是，保证完成任务。”小桃立刻应声，眉开眼笑的模样，哪有方才的小心和忐忑。
陈嫂子点她的脑门儿，末了上前替主子拾掇桌子，小声劝道：“小姐定然又不忍心，想着谁来求医是有急症，但小姐您擅长的是妇科，都是天长日久累积的病症，哪有危及性命的，以至于这么急着来请您的。
“您啊，还是把心放回肚子里，早些睡吧。老夫人早就发话了，天黑就不能再开门。上次您偷偷溜出去，本是一片好心，想着救人一命，但那妇人是难产，您根本帮不上，最后产婆也不成，一尸两命，还怪到您头上，闹得咱们家里不得安宁，老夫人也气得病了半个月。小姐，咱们可不能再乱发善心了啊！”
童悠悠听得有些脸红，心里那点儿好奇就像小小火苗，被奶娘一盆冷水浇灭得彻底。
小桃啃着剩下半个果子，含糊替小姐说话，“陈嫂说的不对，小姐说过啊，世上有坏人就有好人。先前那家人确实混蛋，但也有好的啊，比如戚小姐、蒋姑娘、云姑娘和刘姑娘她们，都是小姐出诊治好了她们的母亲，这才结下的手帕交……”
陈嫂子听不下去，抬手又要敲她。
小桃后知后觉想起方才的教训，双手抱住脑袋，不等挨打，已经哎哟叫了起来。
童悠悠赶紧拦着，无奈道：“陈嫂，小桃的话也有道理，但我以后绝对不再随便出诊，你就别担心了。”
陈嫂子放下手，叹道：“小姐啊，您是我奶大的，我怎么能盼着您不好。您年岁小，不知道世间险恶，尤其是我们这江南之地，多少姑娘就因为流言，被生生逼着悬梁自尽，跳河证清白。您可不能大意啊！老爷在京都，夫人又是……哎，您可一定要好好的，否则老夫人怕是也要……”
“我知道了，陈嫂。”听得京都二字，童悠悠脸色也暗淡三分。
陈嫂子看了有些后悔，张罗着喊小桃一起铺被，伺候小姐洗漱。
很快，童悠悠上了床，陈嫂子嘱咐小桃几句就离开了。
小桃在脚踏上打地铺，方才吃得饱，很快就睡着了，童悠悠却是睁着眼睛睡不着。
方才陈嫂子说她天真，不知世间险恶，这话真是没错。
她前世本是现代的一个菜鸟中医，毕业不到一年，正是在各个科室轮流打杂操练的时候，一场车祸就从童家大夫人的肚子里出来了。
好不容易接受了自己穿越到一个陌生世界，童大夫人又一命呜呼，被童家老夫人接到了台州这里的童家大院。
十几年间，大半时间都圈在这座阁楼里，学规矩，读书，琴棋书画，绣花，简直让她应接不暇。
幸好，童老夫人身体不好，她藉着一个“孝”字，把老本行慢慢捡了起来，古今印证之下，也算进步飞快，让偷偷教授她医术的师傅惊奇不已。
若不是顾忌她是个姑娘家，怕是师傅都要敲锣打鼓昭告天下了。
她原本打算学点儿本事傍身，就算这是个男权至上的封建社会，总能给她机会活出自我，掌控自己的命运。

结果，现实却让她一次次铩羽而归。若不是有祖母和师傅替她收尾遮掩，她如今还不知道落得什么下场。
幸好，上天没有太过残忍，她的争取和努力，到底还是有些收获。解除过一些病人的痛苦，也得到了几份难得的友情……
这般想着，她的眼皮就有些沉，脑子也是开始昏沉。她突然觉得哪里不对劲儿，但也无力反抗，被睡魔扯入了暗黑的深渊……
原本被关紧的窗子轻轻抬了起来，跳进一道黑影，正是在外等候多时的梁浩海，他行了一礼，来到窗前，迟疑了一瞬，到底还是用薄被卷起童悠悠，跳出了窗子……
第二章 最后的叮咛(1)
冯全急得跳脚，虽然余姑娘的刀口不再淌血，但气息微弱至极，脸色金纸一般，眼见就要不行了。
好不容易盼着梁浩海回来，他赶紧迎了上去，“梁哥，怎么样？寻到大夫了吗？”
梁浩海把薄被
“这……梁哥，你把人家姑娘掳来了？”
梁浩海尴尬咳了一声，低声道：“我也是没有办法，这城里只有这姑娘是个女医，非常时期，只能用非常手段。”
冯全还想打量几眼童悠悠的容貌，被梁浩海挡在身前。
content_en:
"Report to the official?" Feng Quan jumped up and was about to curse, "Hurry up and report, I just..."
However, Liang Haohai stopped him. They were doing business in secret, so their identities could not be exposed casually.
He directly took out a silver coin from his purse and threw it to the shopkeeper, "We are only staying for one night. If you don't agree, you will be shameless. Don't blame us for making things difficult for you in the future."
The shopkeeper was just bluffing. Now that he had gotten the money, and seeing that Liang Haohai and the two were not easy to bully, he softened his attitude and responded: "It's not that I don't want to receive her, it's just that this girl is too seriously injured. If we get into a lawsuit, or if this girl has bad luck, our reputation will be ruined, and it will be difficult to do business in the future."
"Don't worry, I won't cause any trouble for you in this store. If there is a vacant room in the backyard, we can arrange one for us. If anything goes wrong, it won't bring any trouble to you."
"Okay, guest, please come with me. There is a wing in the backyard, which is smaller but still clean. It is suitable for this girl to recuperate." The shopkeeper said it well, but in fact, he didn't want them to stay in the inn room. If the girl died in it, future guests would be taboo.
Fortunately, this penthouse was cleaned frequently, and although it was a bit crude, it was still barely enough to stay in.
Liang Haohai asked Feng Quan to keep watch, and he quickly went to look for the Tong family compound.
Unfortunately, after such a delay, the sky had already turned dark. When he found the Tong family's courtyard, the door of the Tong family was closed tightly. No matter how hard he knocked, no one inside responded.
Miss Yu's injuries were too serious and she would die at any time. He couldn't wait any longer, so he could only take the wrong approach...
The Tong family's courtyard is not small, and the Wujin mansion also has a small garden. A two-story attic was built in the northeast corner of the garden, and Tong Youyou, the eldest daughter of the Tong family, lives in it.
In the dark night, the sound could be heard very far and clearly. There was a flapping at the door, and a few sounds were also heard in the attic.
Tong Youyou put down the medical book in her hand, looked towards the door, and asked, "Xiao Tao, do you know who is visiting outside the door?"
Xiaotao was only fifteen years old, fair and plump. Because she had served her master since she was a child, she was well aware of his easy-going temperament and did not feel too reserved. At this moment, while chewing the fruit, she casually responded: "Oh, miss, who is knocking on our door? He must be seeking medical treatment."
She wanted to say a few words, but someone slapped her on the back of her head.
A woman wearing a lotus blue dress came in from the door, glared at Xiaotao angrily, and said angrily: "There are no rules! In a plate of fruit, the lady didn't eat any of it, but you ate half of it!"
The woman who spoke was the eldest lady’s nanny, Sister-in-law Chen. The man in the family was the housekeeper of the Tong Family Courtyard, and she was very trusted by the old lady. Sister-in-law Chen was a cheerful and kind-hearted person, and all the maids in the attic were under her control.
Xiao Tao was so frightened that she took a mouthful of fruit and hurriedly hid next to the lady and asked for help, "Miss, I won't dare to do it next time."
Tong Youyou was amused and looked at Sister-in-law Chen, "Sister-in-law Chen, Xiaotao is still young. Don't argue with her. Just punish her to sweep my yard tomorrow. Besides, I have no appetite. She ate the fruit to avoid wasting it if it wilts tomorrow."
Sister-in-law Chen was not a stern person, so when her master spoke, she naturally couldn't hold on, so she glared at Xiaotao again. Seeing her shrinking her neck and looking cautious, she couldn't help but smile, but she still said: "I won't do it next time. I'll sweep the yard tomorrow morning."
"Yes, I promise to complete the task." Xiao Tao responded immediately, with a cheerful smile, without the caution and anxiety just now.
Sister-in-law Chen tapped her on the forehead, and finally stepped forward to clean the table for the master, and whispered advice: "Miss, I can't bear to think that whoever comes to seek medical treatment has an emergency, but miss, you are good at gynecology, and they are all diseases accumulated over time. How can they be life-threatening, so I am so anxious to come to see you."
"You should put your heart back in your stomach and go to bed early. The old lady had already spoken, and she could not open the door again after dark. superiorThe first time you sneaked out, you had good intentions and wanted to save someone's life, but the woman had a difficult delivery and you couldn't help at all. In the end, the midwife couldn't help either. One person died, two people died, and you were blamed. There was no peace in our family, and the old lady was so angry that she became ill for half a month. Miss, we can no longer show kindness! "
Tong Youyou blushed a little when she heard this, and the curiosity in her heart was like a small flame, which was completely extinguished by the wet nurse with a basin of cold water.
Xiao Tao gnawed on the remaining half of the fruit and spoke vaguely for the young lady, "Sister-in-law Chen is wrong. The young lady said that there are good people as well as bad people in the world. The previous family was indeed a bastard, but there were also good ones, such as Miss Qi, Miss Jiang, Miss Yun, and Miss Liu. It was all the young ladies who went to the clinic and cured their mothers, and that was how we formed the handkerchief relationship..."
Sister-in-law Chen couldn't stand listening and raised her hand to knock her again.
Xiao Tao later remembered the lesson she had just learned, held her head with both hands, and screamed before she was beaten.
Tong Youyou quickly stopped her and said helplessly: "Sister-in-law Chen, what Xiao Tao said makes sense, but I will never visit the doctor casually in the future, so don't worry. "
Sister-in-law Chen put down her hand and sighed: "Miss, you have the biggest breasts of mine, how can I expect anything bad from you. You are young and don't know the dangers of the world, especially in our Jiangnan area. How many girls are forced to hang themselves from a beam because of rumors and jump into a river to prove their innocence. You can't be careless! The master is in Kyoto, and the madam is... Hey, you must be good, otherwise the old lady may also..."
"I understand, Mrs. Chen. "When she heard the word "Kyoto", Tong Youyou's face darkened.
Sister-in-law Chen felt a little regretful after seeing this, and called Xiao Tao to spread the quilt together and help the young lady wash up.
Soon, Tong Youyou went to bed, and Sister-in-law Chen gave Xiao Tao a few words and left.
Xiaotao made the floor on her feet. She had just eaten and fell asleep quickly, but Tong Youyou could not sleep with her eyes open.
Sister-in-law Chen just said that she is naive and does not know the dangers of the world. She is absolutely right.
In her previous life, she was a rookie Chinese medicine doctor in modern times. Less than a year after graduation, while taking turns doing odd jobs in various departments, she suffered a car accident from the belly of Mrs. Tong's family.
After finally accepting that she had traveled to a strange world, Mrs. Tong died again and was taken to the Tong family compound here in Taizhou by the old Mrs. Tong family.
For more than ten years, she spent most of her time in this attic, learning the rules, reading, playing chess, calligraphy, painting, and embroidery, which she couldn't keep up with.
Fortunately, Mrs. Tong was in poor health. She used the word "filial piety" to slowly pick up her old profession. With the confirmation of ancient and modern times, she made rapid progress, which surprised the master who secretly taught her medical skills.
If it weren't for the concern that she was a girl, the master would probably beat gongs and drums to tell the world.
She originally planned to learn some skills to help herself. Even if this was a feudal society dominated by male supremacy, it would always give her the opportunity to live her own life and control her own destiny.
As a result, reality made her frustrated again and again. If her grandmother and master hadn't covered it up for her, she still doesn't know where she would end up.
Fortunately, God is not too cruel, and her efforts and efforts have yielded some results. I have relieved the pain of some patients and gained some rare friendships...
Thinking like this, her eyelids became a little heavy and her mind began to feel dizzy. She suddenly felt that something was wrong, but she was unable to resist and was dragged into the dark abyss by the Sandman...
The originally closed window was gently lifted up, and a dark shadow jumped in. It was Liang Haohai who had been waiting outside for a long time. He bowed and came to the window. He hesitated for a moment, but finally rolled up Tong Youyou with a thin quilt and jumped out of the window...
Chapter 2 Final Instructions (1)
Feng Quan jumped up and down anxiously. Although Miss Yu's knife edge was no longer bleeding, her breath was extremely weak, her face was as golden as paper, and she was about to die.
It’s hard to look forward to Liang HaoWhen Hai came back, he hurriedly greeted him, "Brother Liang, how are you? Have you found the doctor?"
Liang Haohai put the thin quilt
"This...Brother Liang, you kidnapped this girl?"
Liang Haohai coughed in embarrassment and whispered: "I have no choice. This girl is the only female doctor in this city. In extraordinary times, we can only use extraordinary means."
Feng Quan wanted to take a look at Tong Youyou's appearance, but was blocked by Liang Haohai.
